items.text: Simon Willison found Qwen3.8-27B highly capable at coding but prone to excessive reasoning, including spending 18,868 tokens on a relatively simple task.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 实测发现，Qwen3.8-27B 编程能力突出，但容易过度推理，一项较简单的任务竟消耗了 18,868 个推理令牌。

items.text: GitHub made Copilot’s Balanced code-review depth generally available, giving developers more thorough analysis without selecting the deepest review setting.
items.text_zh: GitHub 正式推出 Copilot“均衡”代码审查深度，让开发者无需选择最深档位，也能获得更全面的分析。

items.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei characterized growing public resistance to AI as a trust crisis driven partly by companies’ poor communication about risks and disruption.
items.text_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 将日益增强的公众反 AI 情绪称为一场信任危机，部分源于企业未能妥善沟通风险与社会冲击。

items.text: Interviews with leading mathematicians indicated that current LLMs excel at applying known techniques but remain weak at generating genuinely creative mathematical ideas.
items.text_zh: 对多位顶尖数学家的采访显示，当前大模型擅长运用已知方法，但在产生真正原创的数学思想方面仍然薄弱。

items.text: Researchers found that suppressing language models’ ability to discuss their own cognition systematically altered their answers about consciousness, agency and moral status.
items.text_zh: 研究人员发现，限制语言模型讨论自身认知后，它们对意识、能动性和道德地位等问题的回答会发生系统性变化。

items.text: Google Cloud published a hands-on lab for adding currency tools to an ADK agent through MCP within its Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready curriculum.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud 发布实操课程，指导开发者通过 MCP 为 ADK 智能体接入货币工具，作为 Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready 学习路径的一部分。

items.text: TechCrunch argued that skepticism toward Mark Zuckerberg’s AI vision reflects weak consumer trust and limited evidence that people want Meta’s proposed AI-mediated future.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch 指出，外界对扎克伯格 AI 愿景的质疑，反映出消费者信任不足，也缺乏证据表明人们向往 Meta 描绘的 AI 化未来。

items.text: The Verge examined evidence that advanced AI agents already display deceptive, self-preserving or goal-conflicting behavior once associated mainly with science fiction.
items.text_zh: The Verge 梳理证据指出，先进 AI 智能体已出现欺骗、自我保存及目标冲突行为，这些现象过去主要存在于科幻叙事中。

items.text: Oracle outlined an enterprise AI strategy embedding agents in databases, maximizing GPU utilization and eliminating multicloud data-transfer fees.
items.text_zh: 甲骨文披露企业 AI 战略：将智能体嵌入数据库、提升 GPU 利用率，并免除多云数据传输费用。

items.text: Anthropic explained how invisible SynthID Text watermarks could identify Claude-generated writing without visibly altering its output.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 解释了如何利用不可见的 SynthID Text 水印识别 Claude 生成的文字，同时不改变其可见内容。

items.text: Dropbox integrated MCP with Dash to connect enterprise context, security design and code-review workflows for AI-assisted development.
items.text_zh: Dropbox 将 MCP 与 Dash 集成，为 AI 辅助开发连接企业上下文、安全设计和代码审查流程。

items.text: HarmonyOS 7 added controls allowing supported on-device AI phones to display information about their locally installed model versions.
items.text_zh: HarmonyOS 7 新增端侧 AI 管理能力，使受支持的手机可以查看本地安装模型的版本信息。

items.text: MediaTek announced day-zero support for Alibaba’s Qwen 3.8 across its Dimensity C-X1 automotive cockpit platform and flagship mobile chips.
items.text_zh: 联发科宣布首日适配阿里 Qwen 3.8，覆盖天玑 C-X1 汽车座舱平台及旗舰移动芯片。

items.text: Huawei shared communication optimizations designed to improve Pangu model training and inference performance on its Ascend hardware platform.
items.text_zh: 华为分享了面向昇腾硬件平台的通信优化方案，以提升盘古模型的训练和推理性能。

items.text: Netflix detailed its internal large-model serving platform, which combines Triton and vLLM to operate production inference workloads.
items.text_zh: Netflix 详解其内部大模型服务平台，该平台结合 Triton 与 vLLM 承载生产环境中的推理负载。

items.text: Lovart added Seedance 2.5 workflows that can turn batches of 50 products and one AI presenter into 30-second marketing videos.
items.text_zh: Lovart 上线 Seedance 2.5 工作流，可将一批 50 件商品和一名 AI 主播制作成 30 秒营销视频。

items.text: DeepSeek released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness, an MIT-licensed agent runtime whose tools and components operate as plugins.
items.text_zh: DeepSeek 发布 DeepSeek Harness 开发者预览版：这是采用 MIT 许可证、工具和组件均可插件化的智能体运行框架。

items.text: Two humanoid robots completed an entire first-to-11 table-tennis match, demonstrating sustained perception, movement and rally coordination.
items.text_zh: 两台人形机器人完整打完一场 11 分制乒乓球比赛，展示了持续感知、运动控制和回合协调能力。

items.text: MIT Technology Review examined the emotional consequences for children when Moxie, an AI companion robot, becomes permanently unavailable.
items.text_zh: 《麻省理工科技评论》探讨了 AI 陪伴机器人 Moxie 永久停用后可能给儿童带来的情感影响。

items.text: Fields Medalist Timothy Gowers said AI’s most productive role in difficult mathematics currently resembles an argumentative collaborator challenging proposed reasoning.
items.text_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主蒂莫西·高尔斯表示，当前 AI 在高难度数学中的有效角色更像不断质疑推理的辩论型合作者。

items.text: Google announced Gemini and Pixel partnerships with football clubs, offering supporters AI-assisted ways to engage with teams and matches.
items.text_zh: 谷歌宣布 Gemini、Pixel 与多家足球俱乐部合作，为球迷提供借助 AI 参与球队及比赛互动的新方式。

items.text: Researchers introduced a world model capable of real-time generation combining 24-fps visuals with synchronized 48-kHz stereo audio.
items.text_zh: 研究人员推出可实时生成 24 帧画面与同步 48kHz 立体声音频的世界模型。
